rights_footer: Ebi nibyesigamira ebiragiro bya Uganda ebyatangazibwe. Aga n'amakuru g'ebiragiro, ti buhabuzi bw'ebiragiro.
onboarding_body_1: Kwata ekishushani nari ohereze ekihandiiko kyona kya gavumenti — ebaruha z'omu muhanda, ebaruha z'okubingwa, empapura z'akatare — otunge okushoboorora omu bigambo ebyorobi.
onboarding_body_2: Manya eki ebiragiro bya Uganda birikugamba aha nshonga yaawe. LegalBridge ekozesa ebiragiro ebihamiziibwe kwonka — tihariho kuteebereza.
onboarding_body_3: Tunga eby'okukora kandi okwatanise n'obuhwezi bw'ebiragiro.
onboarding_body_4: Buuza ebibuuzo n'eiraka nari ohandiike omu Rungyereza nari Oruganda. Toine intaneti? Kanda enamba yaitu eya USSD aha simu yoona.
home_boda_desc: Ebaruha z'omu muhanda, obugabe n'amakuru g'ebiragiro
home_ussd_accessibility: Kanda enamba ya USSD okukozesa otaine intaneti
disclaimer_short: LegalBridge ekuha amakuru g'ebiragiro, ti buhabuzi bw'ebiragiro. Aha nshonga enkuru, shaba obuhabuzi bwa puliida ahikiriire.

validation_consentRequired: Oine kwikiriza ngu amakuru gaawe gakozesibwe kubaasa kukomeza.
consent: Nyikiriza LegalBridge kukozesa amakuru gangye kumpa amakuru g'ebiragiro. Ninbaasa kusiimura amakuru gangye obwire bwona.
loginError: Enamba y'esimu nari pasiwaadi tiziri zo.
language_note: Nobaasa kuhindura orurimi obwire bwona omu Ntebekanisa.

legalHelp_subtitle: Ebitongore ebirikuhwera aha by'ebiragiro na bapuliida abahikiriire omu Uganda
legalHelp_uls_description: Ekitongore kya bapuliida omu Uganda. Nikikwohereza ahari bapuliida abahikiriire.
legalHelp_uls_eligibility: Kiri ahabw'abantu boona — nikikwohereza ahari bapuliida abari omu kitongore.
legalHelp_uls_consult: Kwatanisa nabo bakwohereze ahari puliida ahikiriire ari haihi naiwe.
legalHelp_fida_description: Ekitongore kya bakazi abapuliida omu Uganda. Obuhwezi bw'ebiragiro bw'obusha ahabw'abakazi n'amaka.
legalHelp_fida_eligibility: Munonga abakazi n'amaka. Abaine sente nkye nibabanza.
legalHelp_fida_consult: Nobaasa kugyendayo nari kuteera esimu kubuuza.
legalHelp_laspnet_description: Omukago gw'ebitongore ebirikuha obuhwezi bw'ebiragiro omu Uganda yoona.
legalHelp_laspnet_eligibility: Abantu abaine sente nkye. Ebirikwetengyesa nibihinduka okurugiirira aha kitongore.
legalHelp_laspnet_consult: Kwatanisa nabo kumanya ahu obuhwezi bw'ebiragiro buri haihi omu disiturikiti yaawe.
legalAidConnect_subtitle: Toorana disiturikiti yaawe kubona ofiisi y'obuhwezi bw'ebiragiro bw'obusha eri haihi.
legalAidConnect_noOffice: Tihaine enamba ya ofiisi ehamiziibwe ahabw'edisiturikiti egi. Kozesa obuhwezi obundi obuli ahansi.
legalAidConnect_extraHint: Esimu ya ofiisi yaaba neekozesibwa nari etarikukwatwa, gyezaho enamba ezi.
legalAidConnect_note: Obuhabuzi bw'obusha. Aha misango y'omu kooti, shaba puliida ahikiriire.
history_confirmDelete: Noyenda kusiimura ekihandiiko eki? Kunu tikurikubaasa kugarurwa.
profile_confirmDelete: Noyenda kusiimura akaunti yaawe? Amakuru gaawe goona nigeija kusiimurwa.
ussd_body: Kanda aha simu yoona — toyetengyesa smartphone nari intaneti.
ussd_note: USSD neekuha amakuru g'ebiragiro agabanza. Okucondooza ebihandiiko, kozesa app egi.
voice_microphonePermission: Ebibuuzo by'eiraka nibyetengyesa okwikiriza kukozesa maikurofoni.

voice_synthesisUnavailable: Okushoma n'eiraka tikuriho. Ninkushaba oshome ebihandiikirwe.

upload_photoPermission: LegalBridge neetengyesa okwikirizibwa kureeba ebishushani byawe.
